error.summary: Two demonstrated defects: positive scaling preserves answer-bank shortcuts, including every surviving batch record; complete easy source q-20450 is omitted. Mathematics, grading, rendering and packaging checks passed. Package files are unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve a three-variable triangular system using back substitution and select its ordered solution vector.
reasoning_steps: Read the third variable from the last equation.
Substitute both known values into the first equation.
invariants: Three equations with unit leading coefficients and a unique solution.
Two substitution stages using easy signed integer and rational arithmetic.
One correct vector among five radio choices.
permitted_variations: Vary small signed right-hand sides and supported coefficients while preserving workload.
Allow solution signs, zero coordinates and incidental coordinate relationships to change.
Use source-supported variable names and angle or column vectors.
source_refs: Tutorial 4d84a9a0-94f9-57e2-a8e6-333ba26d72e4: start with the lowest equation and substitute upward until all variables are found.

source_replay.details: All 11 supported profiles reproduce their source equations and complete banks. Complete easy q-20450 is rejected. Incomplete q-20451 is documented separately.

math.details: Independent exact solutions, unique correct choices and displayed substitution equalities passed for 33 samples, five batch records and three controlled records.

variety.details: Conditional bank-only strategies succeed on 33/33 samples and 5/5 batch records, including all 28 and four respective delivery survivors. Positive scaling preserves signs, equalities and ordering within each profile.

scope.details: Tested outputs preserve the source equation structure, two substitution stages, rational arithmetic and five-choice vector response.

grading.details: Native grader correctly handled 275 responses: 111 accepted and 164 rejected, including shortcut-produced submissions. All fields are radio.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendering and screenshot inspection confirmed notation, controls and worked solutions. UI shuffling preserves the demonstrated order-independent shortcuts. Long-equation overflow in a reviewer-created counterfactual is documented.

packaging.details: Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 match the manifest. Determinism, relocation and invalid-input rejection passed. Package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Scaling and renaming dependencies passed, but eligible answer roles remain fixed. Shortcuts survive delivery filtering and every nonempty eligible subset of the surviving batch. Captured inventory basis 5578 contains only original sources, with no historical generated records to repair.

findings.description: Scaling every RHS and source-bank coordinate by the same positive integer freezes incidental answer-bearing patterns. For q-129453, choosing the sole vector with a positive middle coordinate always succeeds without using the RHSs. Similar conditional rules cover all 11 profiles and every surviving batch record.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python probe_shortcuts.py --strict; it fails on the demonstrated shortcuts. Minimal generator case: run that Python executable on ../workspace/17592186096669.py --seed 73421 --profile q-129453 --scale 4 --count 1. The bank is (0,-16,-8), (24,-16,-8), (24,16,-8), (24,0,-8), (8,0,-8); only the correct vector has a positive middle coordinate. Exact batch example: q-10195 scale 3 is answered by choosing the negative first coordinate closest to zero. Complete records and native submissions are retained.

Derive valid distractors for those instances, retain source replay and strict shortcut regressions, and regenerate the candidate batch. Choice shuffling alone cannot fix this.
